integrity: The proof reduces the infinite domain to fifteen exact prime triples using the monotonicity of \(H(t)=(t+1)/(t-1)\), then determines the final prime by one rational formula. The attached exact-arithmetic replay is corroborative and does not substitute for the finite-reduction proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to squarefree integers with exactly four distinct prime factors. It does not classify nonsquarefree four-support solutions or support size at least five.
title: The squarefree four-prime layer of \(\sigma(n)=2\varphi(n)\)
